summary: This directory is dedicated to the execution and verification of package concepts within a pipeline architecture. It provides the infrastructure to run specific operations related to package concepts and includes testing suites to ensure the correctness of these execution processes.
responsibilities: Execute package concept operations within defined pipelines
Validate the functionality of execution logic through automated testing
relationships: The execution logic interacts with the package concept to perform specific pipeline operations.
The test suite validates the internal mechanics of the package concept executor.
designDecisions: Colocation of test files with source code for direct verification
Isolation of execution logic from pipeline orchestration
